source: Euratlas Periodis 1600 (Nüssli), maps viewed on euratlas.net, sampled at place centres
method: Identity from the per-entity maps (one shared frame; red outline = held in sovereignty, green outline/tint = held as a dependency), filled to area masks (ray-parity inside test; colour fill checked by parity where outlines failed). Sovereign = smallest sovereign mask covering the pixel, dependent = smallest dependent mask (or a sovereign holding the land under another). Geometry: the four quarter maps are 0.59x crops of the entity frame; the entity frame is the same as in 1300, so the 1300 fit (55 cities measured as dots on the 1300 quarters, 3rd-order polynomial) is used and checked against this year's quarter maps (residuals_px). Each place is sampled in the entity frame (3x3 majority) and on the quarter maps (flat-colour segment of the place, labelled by entity-raster majority); weighted vote. No regional maps. confidence = vote share x local agreement; -1 = outside Euratlas coverage or unmapped (desert/white).
